answer: To secure an agent economy against Sybil attacks, a decentralized ledger can require each AI node to stake a cryptographic crystal representing locked capital. The protocol then binds agent reputation to a verifiable data lineage, tracing identity legitimacy much like an indelible pigment fixed to a unique weaving thread. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities incurs a prohibitive financial penalty, as every fraudulent node demands a proportional locking of scarce native assets and continuous expenditure of verifiable proof-of-work resources.
